behavior: A control in a field keeps the `id` of the developer in the server HTML when no `Field.Label` of the field renders before it, and a label that renders after the control has that `id` in `for`. When a label renders before the control, the control has the generated id of the field until the hydration, because that label names the generated id. Then the control takes its `id`, and the label follows. In each order, the label names the control in the server HTML. Base UI gives each control in a field the generated id until the hydration, also where no label needs it.
